blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce TokenStream, an optimization-based framework that composes independently learned subject identities in text-to-video generation without a reference-video training dataset or joint optimization of each new subject combination. Learning from a single reference image makes subject appearance difficult to separate from static-image bias, while merging independently trained adapters can mix identities. Token-wise LoRA (ToRA) restricts low-rank updates to the cross-attention value projections of subject-associated text tokens, providing a separate adaptation path for each subject. A T2V-guided stream copies queries and keys from the frozen base model during early denoising to reuse its layout and motion priors while retaining personalized values. We also introduce Multi-DB, a 30-subject, 122-prompt benchmark with appearance-free prompts and varied interactions. On Multi-DB at 1.3B, TokenStream improves identity preservation from 0.422 for DreamBooth to 0.467 and textual alignment from 0.652 to 0.688.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了TokenStream,这是一个基于优化的框架,它编集了文本到视频生成中独立学习的主题身份,没有参考视频培训数据集,也没有对每个新主题组合进行联合优化. 从单一的参考图像中学习,使主体外观难以与静态图像偏差区分开来,同时合并独立训练的适配器可以混合身份. Token-wise LoRA (TORA) 将低级更新限制在主题相关文本符号的交叉意向值预测,为每个主题提供了单独的适应路径. 一个T2V制导的流复制了冷冻基模型的查询和密钥,在早期去诺重新使用其布局和运动前缀同时保留个性化值. 我们还采用了多功能数据库,这是一个30个主体、122个即时基准,具有无外观提示和各种互动。 在1.3B的Multi-DB上,TokenStream将身份保护从DreamBooth的0.422改进为0.467,文本对齐从0.652改进为0.688.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multi-subject personalized video generation aims to generate a video that follows a text prompt while faithfully depicting multiple target subjects given as reference images, with applications from filmmaking to personalized advertising.
The task is difficult because it requires an accurate correspondence between visual subjects and their textual descriptions, and consistent identity, motion and interaction across frames.
Models adapted to static subject images also struggle to animate them, producing rigid or stationary appearances.
blocks.zh:
多主题个性化视频生成旨在生成一个跟随文本提示的视频,同时忠实地描绘作为参考图像给出的多个目标主题,其应用从电影制作到个性化广告.
这项任务很困难,因为它需要视觉主体与其文字描述之间的精确对应,以及一致的特性,运动和跨帧的相互作用.
适应静态主题图像的模型也难以使其动起来,产生刚性或固定的外观.

blocks.en:
Existing methods fall into two categories. Training-based approaches [ 34 , 25 , 12 , 11 , 21 , 50 , 57 , 30 , 56 , 5 , 22 , 58 , 10 , 31 , 8 ] inject reference subjects during model training.
They are effective but require large-scale, high-quality video-reference pairs that are expensive to collect, and fine-tuning on such data can degrade the generative quality of the pretrained T2V model. Optimization-based approaches [ 6 , 46 , 24 , 48 , 7 , 49 , 23 , 1 ] instead optimize subject-specific parameters, and most derive from DreamBooth [ 41 ] or Textual Inversion (TI) [ 13 ] .
DreamBooth improves appearance fidelity by updating weights or adapters, but multi-subject composition is hard because independently trained adapters interfere.
TI learns one token embedding per subject and composes naturally, yet its capacity is limited to the text embedding space and it captures incomplete identity details.
Both also overfit static reference images, weakening motion dynamics and prompt adherence.
blocks.zh:
现有方法分为两类。 基于培训的方针[34,25,12,11,21,50,57,30,56,5,22,58,10,31,8]在示范培训中注入参考课题.
它们很有效,但需要大规模、高质量的视频参考对,收集费用昂贵,对这些数据进行微调可降低预先训练的T2V模型的基因质量。 基于优化的方法 [6, 46, 24, 48, 7, 49, 23, 1] 转而优化主题特定参数, 多数来源于 DreamBooth [41] 或 Textal Inversion (TI) [13].
DreamBooth通过更新权重或适配器来提高外观的忠贞性,但多主体成分很困难,因为独立训练的适配器干扰.
TI学习每个主体一个符号嵌入并自然地作曲,然而其容量仅限于文本嵌入空间,并捕捉不完整的身份细节.
两者都过于适应静态参考图像,削弱运动动力学,并迅速坚持.

blocks.en:
We therefore introduce TokenStream, with two components. (1) Token-wise LoRA (ToRA). Unlike TI, which learns a single embedding vector per subject token, ToRA assigns a dedicated LoRA [ 20 ] to each subject-relevant token within the Text-to-Value projection of every cross-attention layer.
This greatly expands capacity for fine-grained identity while keeping the compositional flexibility of text-driven control, so multiple subjects combine without additional optimization. (2) T2V-guided stream. At inference, an auxiliary stream driven by the frozen T2V model steers the denoising trajectory of the personalized stream, reusing the pretrained motion and layout priors while retaining the subject-specific value features learned by ToRA.
Unlike image-based methods that transfer K K and V V , we copy Q Q and K K to transfer attention structure while letting the main stream inject personalized appearance.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们介绍TokenStream,有两个组成部分。 (1) 明智的LORA(TORA)。 与TI学习单个嵌入向量的每个主题符号不同,TORA在文本到值投影中为每个交叉投影层中每个主题相关的符号分配一个专用的LORA [20].
这大大扩展了精细的标识能力,同时保持了文本驱动控制在构成上的灵活性,因此多个主体组合在一起,而没有额外的优化. (2) T2V导流. 推论中,由冷冻的T2V模型驱动的辅助流引导个性化流的去诺化轨迹,在保留TORA所学到的主题特定值特性的同时,重新使用预训运动和布局前缀.
与基于图像的方法转移K K和V V 不同,我们复制Q Q和K K 以转移注意力结构,同时让主流注入个性化外观.

blocks.en:
The current mainstream benchmark, OpenS2V [ 53 ] , exhibits limitations: (i) its prompts contain limited motion diversity and subject interaction, and (ii) detailed appearance descriptions undermine the personalization objective, as the model should learn subjects from reference images rather than the prompt itself.
To enable more realistic evaluation, we introduce Multi-DB, a new benchmark built on DreamBench [ 41 ] .
Multi-DB contains 30 subjects and 122 prompts, including 76 two-subject and 46 three-subject compositions, with richer motion dynamics and higher compositional complexity.
The prompts are designed to avoid explicit appearance descriptions.
Thus, Multi-DB is designed to test three specific weaknesses of existing benchmarks: prompts that reveal the subject appearance, simple subject interactions, and limited motion diversity.

为了能够进行更现实的评价,我们采用了基于Dream Bench [41] 的新基准Multi-DB。

因此,Multi-DB旨在测试现有基准的三个具体弱点:揭示主体外观的提示,简单的主体相互作用,以及有限的运动多样性.

blocks.en:
We build our proposed method on Wan2.1 [ 44 ] , a pretrained video generation framework, and evaluate it on both our proposed benchmark and OpenS2V [ 53 ] .
We compare our approach with TI and DreamBooth as optimization-based baselines, as well as training-based methods including VACE [ 25 ] , Phantom [ 34 ] , MAGREF [ 11 ] , and Skyreels-A2 [ 12 ] .
Our method improves identity preservation and textual alignment over the evaluated TI and DreamBooth baselines, while offering a complementary trade-off to training-based approaches without large-scale reference-video training.
blocks.zh:
我们用Wan2.1[44]这个经过预先培训的视频生成框架来构建我们拟议的方法,并用我们拟议的基准和OpenS2V[53]来评价它。
我们将我们的方法与TI和DreamBooth作为基于优化的基线以及基于培训的方法进行比较,包括VACE [25],Phantom [34],MAGREF [11],和Skyreels-A2 [12].
我们的方法比评估的TI和DreamBooth基线改进了身份保存和文字协调,同时在不进行大规模参考视频培训的情况下,为基于培训的办法提供补充性权衡。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We present TokenStream , a novel optimization-based framework for multi-subject personalized video generation, featuring ToRA, a token-wise LoRA fine-tuning technique for precise textual control. • To address subject overfitting that limits motion and prompt following, we introduce the T2V-guided stream, an inference-time method that transfers attention structure while retaining personalized values. • We establish Multi-DB , a new benchmark for multi-subject video personalization designed to reduce prompt leakage and increase motion and interaction complexity.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Video Generation Model. Recent progress in diffusion-based video generation has markedly expanded creative capabilities.
Early video diffusion models relied on U-Net denoisers, as in Stable Video Diffusion [ 4 ] and AnimateDiff [ 17 ] , while recent systems increasingly adopt DiT-based architectures [ 39 ] .
These models mainly follow two designs: MMDiT-based models, such as CogVideoX [ 51 ] and HunyuanVideo [ 26 ] , and cross-attention-based models, such as Wan2.1 [ 44 ] , Cosmos [ 3 ] , and LTX-Video [ 18 ] .
MMDiT jointly attends over text and visual tokens, making precise token-level intervention less direct.
In contrast, cross-attention-based architectures decouple self-attention from cross-attention, enabling targeted modulation of subject-relevant text tokens.
Capitalizing on this advantage, we adopt Wan2.1 as our base T2V model.
blocks.zh:
视频生成模式. 最近在传播视频制作方面取得的进展显著扩大了创作能力。
早期的视频传播模型依赖于U-Net denoisers,如在Stable Video Difusion [4]和AnimateDiff [17]中,而最近的系统则越来越多地采用基于DiT的架构[39].
这些模型主要遵循两种设计:基于MMDiT的模型,如CogVideoX [51]和HunyuanVideo [26],以及基于交叉的模型,如Wan2.1 [44],Cosmos [3],和LTX-Video [18].
MMdiT联合参与文字和视觉符号,使精确的符号级干预不那么直接.
与此相反,基于交叉的架构将自觉与交叉的自觉脱钩,从而能够有针对性地调制与主题相关的文本符号.
利用这一优势,我们采用Wan2.1作为我们的T2V基型.

blocks.en:
Personalized/Subject-driven Image Generation. Personalization methods adapt pretrained generative models to learn a subject from one or a few reference images.
Training-based methods [ 29 , 52 , 55 , 47 , 19 ] introduce subject information through learned encoders or adapters, but require large-scale, high-quality image-reference pairs.
Optimization-based methods update text embeddings [ 13 , 2 , 43 , 37 ] or model weights [ 41 , 14 ] .
Textual Inversion (TI) [ 13 ] enables flexible subject composition via learned tokens but is limited by the text embedding space.
DreamBooth-style approaches better preserve appearance through weight updates, yet independently trained LoRAs do not compose well for multiple subjects.
Recent extensions such as ConceptSplit [ 32 ] and TokenVerse [ 15 ] improve token-level expressiveness, but they focus on image generation.
A related scene-aware and agentic line explores controllable visual creation through scene reasoning and tool use, such as JarvisArt [ 33 ] and IR3D-Bench [ 35 ] . Since these works operate at the planning, tool-use, or evaluation level, they are complementary to our model-level focus on subject binding rather than direct baselines.
In contrast, we target multi-subject personalized video generation, where identity must remain stable while motion and prompt-conditioned interactions are preserved.
blocks.zh:
个性化/主体驱动的图像生成. 个性化方法适应预先训练的基因模型,从一个或几个参考图像中学习一个课题.
基于培训的方法[29,52,55,47,19]通过学习的编码器或适配器引入主题信息,但需要大规模,高质量的图像参考对.
基于优化的方法更新文本嵌入[13,2,43,37]或模型权重[41,14].
文本反转(TI)[13]通过学到的符号可以实现灵活的主题组成,但受到文本嵌入空间的限制.
DreamBooth风格的方法通过重量更新来更好地保存外观,然而独立训练的LORAs对多个学科的构思并不理想.
最近的扩展如ConceptSplit [32] 和TokenVerse [15] 改进了符号级的表达性,但它们专注于图像生成.
相关的场景意识和代理线通过场景推理和工具使用探索可控视觉创作,如JarvisArt [33]和IR3D-Bench [35]. 由于这些作品在规划、工具使用或评价层面运作,它们补充了我们模式层面对主题约束而不是直接基线的关注。
相比之下,我们的目标是制作多主题的个性化视频,其中身份必须保持稳定,同时保持运动和快速的有条件互动。

blocks.en:
Multi-subject Personalized Video Generation. Personalized video generation aims to produce prompt-aligned videos that faithfully depict specific subjects given their reference images.
Existing approaches largely fall into two categories. Training-based approaches [ 34 , 25 , 12 , 11 , 21 , 50 , 57 , 30 , 56 , 5 , 22 , 58 , 10 , 31 , 8 ] incorporate subject information directly during model training.
For example, Phantom [ 34 ] fuses subject images with video and text modalities, and ID-Crafter [ 38 ] studies compositional multi-subject generation through VLM-grounded online reinforcement learning.
These methods are powerful but rely on large-scale video-reference pairs that are costly to curate and computationally intensive to train on.
blocks.zh:
多主题 影视世代. 个性化的视频生成旨在制作即时的视频,这些视频忠实地描绘了参考图像中的特定主题.
现有办法基本上分为两类。 基于培训的方针[34,25,12,11,21,50,57,30,56,5,22,58,10,31,8]在示范培训中直接纳入主题信息.
例如,Phantom [34] 将主题图像与视频和文本模式结合,ID-Crafter [38] 通过基于VLM的在线强化学习,研究组成多主题生成.
这些方法很有力,但依靠大型的视频参考对子,这些对子成本高昂,在计算上密集进行训练。

blocks.en:
Optimization-based approaches [ 6 , 46 , 24 , 48 , 7 , 49 , 23 , 1 ] personalize generative models by directly optimizing subject-specific parameters.
Most build upon DreamBooth [ 41 ] or TI [ 13 ] .
VideoDreamer [ 6 ] , CustomVideo [ 46 ] , DisenStudio [ 7 ] , and DynamicConcept [ 1 ] study subject appearance or motion adaptation.
VideoMage [ 23 ] learns subject and motion LoRAs using a motion-reference video and combines them through optimized fusion and collaborative sampling.
Our setting uses one image per subject and no motion-reference video; a controlled comparison with recent video-specific optimization methods remains future work.
Other works explicitly model multi-subject interactions [ 16 , 27 , 28 ] , yet still depend on extra fine-tuning for strong composition.
By contrast, our method supports flexible textual control and multi-subject video personalization without additional optimization steps.
blocks.zh:
优化型方法 [6, 46, 24, 48, 7, 49, 23, 1] 通过直接优化主题特定参数,实现基因模型的个性化.
大部分建立在 梦波 [41] 或 TI [13].
视频梦想器 [6],CustomVideo [46],DisenStudio [7],和动态概念 [1] 研究主题外观或运动适应.
VideoMage [23] 使用运动参考视频学习主题和运动LORAs,并通过优化聚变和协作采样将其结合.
我们的设定使用每个题材一个图像,没有动作参考视频;与近期视频特定优化方法进行对照仍然是今后的工作。
其他作品明确模拟多主体互动[16,27,28],但仍取决于额外微调以形成强构成.
相比之下,我们的方法支持灵活的文字控制和多主体视频个性化,而没有额外的优化步骤.

Method overview. Our TokenStream is an optimization-based framework built on Wan2.1 [ 44 ] , a cross-attention-based T2V model.
It comprises Token-wise LoRA (ToRA) for subject adaptation during fine-tuning and a T2V-guided stream, activated only at inference time, as shown in Fig. 2 .
We first introduce ToRA, then present the T2V-guided stream for mitigating static-image overfitting, and finally describe the Multi-DB benchmark.

我们首先引入TORA,然后呈现T2V导流以缓解静态图像过度适应,最后描述多DB基准.

blocks.en: 3.1 Token-wise LoRA
blocks.zh: 3.1 明智的洛拉

blocks.en:
Textual Inversion (TI) [ 13 ] is a common approach for multi-subject personalized video generation.
It learns textual embeddings for subject-relevant tokens, making it flexible for composition, but its capacity is limited by the text embedding space.
DreamBooth [ 41 ] improves identity preservation by adapting model weights, yet independently trained LoRAs are difficult to combine for arbitrary multi-subject prompts.

它学习与主题相关的符号的文字嵌入,使其在组成上具有灵活性,但其容量受到文字嵌入空间的限制.
DreamBooth [41]通过调整模型权重来改进身份保存,然而独立训练的LORA却难以结合任意的多题提示.

We keep the text encoder and its vocabulary frozen; no new learned identifier embedding is introduced.
Routing assigns each subject a disjoint span of token indices, rather than attaching one adapter to every occurrence of the same word.

The factors are shared across the tokens in one subject span within a layer, and learned separately for each subject and layer.

blocks.en: 3.2 T2V-Guided Stream

blocks.en:
Although ToRA expands the representational capacity for subject identity, learning from static reference images can entangle identity learning with motion modeling.
Unlike U-Net-based video models such as SVD [ 4 ] , Wan2.1 adopts a unified DiT architecture without dedicated motion-specific modules.
Fine-tuning on still images can therefore encode static-image bias into the model, degrading motion fidelity and prompt alignment.

虽然TORA扩展了主题身份的表达能力,但从静态参考图像中学习可以将身份学习与运动建模纠缠在一起.
与SVD[4]等基于U-Net的视频模型不同,Wan2.1采用统一的DiT架构,没有专门的运动专用模块.
因此,对静态图像进行精细调整可以将静态图像偏差编码成模型,降低运动忠贞度并迅速对齐.

blocks.en:

During inference, we retain the frozen base T2V model as a motion prior and copy its Q Q and K K features into the personalized generation stream.
The guided stream shares the same weights as the main stream and simply has no ToRA attached, so no second model is held in memory.
Both streams start from the same noise z T ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) z_{T}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1) .
At each timestep t t and layer l l , we copy the query and key matrices, Q W t , l Q_{W}^{t,l} and K W t , l K_{W}^{t,l} , from the guided stream to the main stream, while the main stream computes its own value features.

Why copy Q , K Q,K ? The queries and keys determine the attention weights, whereas values carry the content being aggregated.
ToRA personalizes the cross-attention values, so copying generic values can suppress the subject information that adaptation learned.
The ablation is consistent with this mechanism: K , V K,V copying yields higher TA (0.714) but lower IP (0.401) than Q , K Q,K copying (TA 0.689, IP 0.469).
These results support a design trade-off, rather than proving that attention maps alone determine motion.

blocks.en: 3.3 Multi-subject DreamBooth Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3.3 多主题梦想库基准

blocks.en:
Several approaches [ 23 , 7 ] evaluate with private prompts built from image personalization datasets [ 41 , 28 ] .
OpenS2V [ 53 ] provides an official benchmark for subject-driven video generation, but its multi-subject prompts are simple in motion and interaction, many of them describe the subjects’ appearance in detail, which defeats the purpose of personalization, and they do not consistently bind an explicit subject token to each reference image.
Our prompts instead focus on motion and interaction, avoid appearance descriptions, and bind subject tokens to reference images explicitly, as illustrated in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh:
几种方法[23、7]利用从图像个性化数据集建立的私人提示进行评价[41、28]。
OpenS2V [53] 为主题驱动的视频生成提供了官方基准,但其多主题提示在动作和互动上都很简单,许多提示详细描述了主体的外表,这违背了个性化的目的,它们并没有始终将一个明确的主题符号绑在每一个参考图像上.
我们的提示关注运动和交互, 避免外观描述,

blocks.zh: 图3:多开发银行增加的内容。 外观无阻的提示测试参考身份;更丰富的相互作用和四个运动-困难水平的压力组成和动态. 实例和表格将即时设计与OpenS2V-Eval进行比较.

blocks.en:
To this end, we introduce Multi-DB , a benchmark for the multi-subject setting.
It uses 30 subjects from DreamBench [ 41 ] covering 15 classes of living and non-living entities, and 122 prompts with two and three subjects, categorized into four motion-difficulty levels.
OpenS2V’s evaluated multi-subject subset contains 68 subjects and 32 prompts (24 two-subject and 8 three-subject prompts).
Initial interaction prompts were generated with ChatGPT before any tuning of our method, then manually revised and verified; the instruction, subject statistics, and verification protocol are in the supplement.
Multi-DB is a targeted stress test for three weaknesses of existing benchmarks, namely appearance leakage in prompts, simple interactions and limited motion diversity, and is not meant to replace OpenS2V, which has more subjects but fewer and simpler prompts; we therefore report both.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们引入了多主题数据库,这是多主题设置的基准。
它使用来自Dream Bench [41] 的30个科目,涵盖15个类的活实体和非活实体,122个有2个和3个科目的提示,分类为4个运动困难级别.
OpenS2V评价的多题子集包含68题和32题(24题和8题三题).
在对我们的方法进行任何调试之前,先与 ChatGPT 生成初步交互提示,然后手动修改和核实;指令、主题统计和核查协议都在补编中。
多数据库是对现有基准中三个弱点的针对性压力测试,这三个弱点是:亮点的外观渗漏、简单的相互作用和有限的运动多样性,目的不是要取代OpenS2V,因为OpenS2V的主题更多,但提示更少,更简单;因此,我们报告两者。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
Datasets and setting. We evaluate on Multi-DB (30 subjects; 76 two-subject and 46 three-subject prompts) and the multi-subject subset of OpenS2V-Eval [ 53 ] (68 subjects; 32 prompts).
The main evaluation concerns non-human subjects and uses a single reference image per subject.
Multi-DB tests appearance-free prompts and varied interactions; OpenS2V supplies a complementary public evaluation.
blocks.zh:
数据集与设置. 我们评价多主题数据库(30个主题;76个双主题和46个三主题提示)和OpenS2V-Eval的多主题子集[53](68个主题;32个提示)。
主要评价涉及非人类主体,每个主体使用单一的参考图像.
多DB测试无外观提示和多种交互;OpenS2V提供辅助性公众评价.

blocks.en:
Evaluation metrics and motion caveats. Following OpenS2V [ 53 ] , we report Identity Preservation (IP) and Textual Alignment (TA) using GME [ 54 , 45 ] , and Visual Quality (VQ) using an LAION aesthetic predictor [ 42 ] .
We also report Motion Smoothness (MS) and Motion Amplitude (MA) in the benchmark and ablation tables. Neither MS nor MA is a reliable optimization target or a test of motion realism. MS can reward nearly static scenes, while optical-flow amplitude can increase because of flicker or structural artifacts rather than coherent movement.
Consequently, lower MS or higher MA alone does not establish a motion improvement, and we use no thresholds to declare motion success.
blocks.zh:
评估尺度和运动说明。 在OpenS2V[53]之后,我们使用GME[54,45]报告身份保存和文本对齐(TA),使用LAION美学预测器报告视觉质量(VQ)[42].
我们还在基准和指数表中报告运动平滑度(MS)和运动振幅(MA)。 MS和MA都不是可靠的优化目标或运动现实主义的测试. MS可以奖励近乎静态的场景,而光学流的振幅会因为闪烁或结构文物而非连贯的运动而增加.
因此,单靠较低的MS或更高的MA并不能实现运动改进,我们没有使用阈值来宣布运动成功.

blocks.en:
Implementation details. We use Wan2.1-T2V [ 44 ] , 750 adaptation steps per subject, batch size 1, rank 16, AdamW [ 36 ] , and learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} with the loss in Eq. 3 .
Inference uses 50 sampling steps, CFG 5.0, 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution, 81 frames, and T W = 20 T_{W}=20 .
We evaluate 1.3B and 14B backbones; ablation sweeps use the 1.3B model and a 20-prompt Multi-DB validation set.
Auxiliary-study settings are reported separately in the supplement.

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison with State-of-the-Art
blocks.zh: 4.1 与艺术国家的比较

blocks.en:
Quantitative results. Tables 2 and 2 summarize results on Multi-DB and OpenS2V-Eval [ 53 ] .
On Multi-DB, Textual Inversion has low IP and TA because it fails to capture detailed appearance, while DreamBooth can suffer from subject mixing and static-reference overfitting when independently learned adapters are merged.
Our method balances identity preservation and prompt alignment while composing independently learned subjects.
Training-based methods reach higher absolute identity scores in several settings, and we do not claim otherwise.
On OpenS2V at 14B, MAGREF (IP 0.567) and Skyreels-A2 (IP 0.527) are ahead of TokenStream (IP 0.482); at 1.3B, Phantom leads on Multi-DB IP (0.510 vs. 0.467).
Within the evaluated optimization-based baselines, the gap in identity and textual alignment is consistently in our favour: on Multi-DB at 1.3B, TokenStream improves IP from 0.347 (TI) and 0.422 (DreamBooth) to 0.467, and TA from 0.392 and 0.652 to 0.688.
Among the evaluated personalized methods, TokenStream also achieves the best TA on Multi-DB at both model sizes and the best IP at 1.3B on OpenS2V-Eval, without large-scale reference-video training.
blocks.zh:
量化结果。 表2和2汇总了多数据库和OpenS2V-Eval的成果[53].
在Multi-DB上,Textual Inversion由于无法捕捉到详细的外观,所以IP和TA都比较低,而DreamBooth在独立学习的适配器被合并后,可能会遇到主题混合和静态引用偏差的问题.
我们的方法平衡了身份的保存和迅速的校对,同时编组独立学习的科目.
基于培训的方法在若干场合达到更高的绝对身份分数,我们并不主张相反.
在14B的OpenS2V上,MAGREF(IP 0.567)和Skyreels-A2(IP 0.527)领先于TokenStream(IP 0482);在1.3B上,Phantom leads on multi-DB IP(0.510 vs. 0/467).
在经过评价的基于优化的基线中,身份和文字对齐的差距始终有利于我们:在1.3B的多数据库上,TokenStream将IP从0.347(TI)和0.422(DreamBooth)改进为0.467,TA从0.392和0.652改进为0.688。
在被评价的个性化方法中,TokenStream还以两种模型大小在多数据库上实现了最佳TA,在OpenS2V-Eval上实现了1.3B的最佳IP,没有大规模参考视频训练.

blocks.en:
Computational cost. The T2V-guided stream shares one copy of the frozen Wan2.1 weights with the main stream, and ToRA is a per-token low-rank branch used only in the main stream.
Sharing weights avoids doubling the model parameters, but guidance still incurs additional model evaluations, latent state, and activations during the first T W = 20 T_{W}=20 of 50 steps.
“Lightweight” therefore refers to the per-subject adaptation cost, about 4 minutes and 5.6 MB without a reference-video dataset, rather than per-video latency.
The supplement reports measured auxiliary inference costs and their settings.
blocks.zh:
计算成本。 T2V导流与主流共用一份冷冻的Wan2.1重量,TORA是只用于主流的每趾低级分支.
共享权重避免了模型参数的翻倍,但指导在50个步骤中的第1个TW = 20 TQQW}=20中仍然需要额外的模型评价,潜伏状态和激活.
因此,“重量”是指每个主体的适应成本,大约为4分钟和5.6 MB,没有参考视频数据集,而不是每视频延迟。
补充报告衡量了辅助推论费用及其设置。

blocks.en:
Motion-level breakdown. Table 5 reports the breakdown over the four Multi-DB motion levels.
As prompts become more dynamic, MS decreases and MA increases; TA also decreases, showing that complex subject interactions remain challenging.
These motion statistics are descriptive, as discussed above.
blocks.zh:
运动级别分解. 表5按四个多开发银行的动能水平分列。
随着电源更加活跃,MS减少,MA增加;TA也减少,表明复杂的主题互动仍然具有挑战性.
如上文所述,这些运动统计是描述性的。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Qualitative comparisons on Multi-DB. Selected examples illustrate subject binding and prompt-conditioned composition. They do not establish reliable articulated motion or success on every scene; omission, identity mixing, and same-class failures are shown in the supplement.
blocks.zh: 图4:多开发银行定性比较。 某些例子说明主题具有约束力和条件迅速的组成。 它们并没有在每一个场景上建立可靠的清晰的动作或成功;附加品中显示了遗漏,身份混合,以及同级失败.

blocks.en:
Qualitative Results. Figure 4 compares methods in multi-object scenarios.
In the examples shown, TokenStream separates subjects clearly, whereas Phantom and VACE sometimes omit a requested subject and Textual Inversion fails to capture the subject.
blocks.zh:
定性结果. 图4比较了多对象情景中的方法.
在所显示的例子中,TokenStream将主题明确区分开来,而Phantom和VACE有时会省略所请求的主题,Textual Inversion未能捕捉到主题.

blocks.en:
User Study. We further conduct a user study with 10 participants over four criteria: visual quality (VQ), motion quality (MQ), textual alignment (TA), and identity preservation (IP).
Participants viewed anonymized and shuffled outputs and selected the preferred result under each criterion.
Users preferred TokenStream across all criteria ( Tab. 5 ).

用户研究. 我们进一步开展了一项用户研究,有10人参加,标准超过4个:视觉质量(VQ)、运动质量(MQ)、文字校正(TA)和身份保护(IP)。

用户更喜欢跨越所有标准的TokenStream(Tab. 5).

blocks.en:
What each component contributes. In the component sweep of Tab. 3 , replacing TI with ToRA without guidance raises IP from 0.390 to 0.420, while TA falls from 0.664 to 0.641.
More adaptation capacity therefore improves appearance but does not by itself retain prompt-conditioned dynamics.
Adding guidance to ToRA raises both TA (0.641 to 0.689) and IP (0.420 to 0.469).
Guidance with TI instead raises IP but sharply lowers TA to 0.455, indicating that borrowing attention structure is insufficient without a suitable personalized value path.
blocks.zh:
每个部分都贡献了什么。 在 Tab 的组件扫描中。 3,在没有制导的情况下用TRA取代TI将IP从0.390提高到0.420,而TA则从0.664下降到0.641.
因此,更多的适应能力可以改善外观,但本身并不能保持迅速的动态。
向托拉公司添加指导可提高TA(0.641至0.689)和IP(0.420至0.469)。
与TI的指引反而将IP但大幅降低到TA的0.455,表明借款关注结构不够,没有合适的个性化价值路径.

blocks.en:
Why adapt values and retain personalized content. The projection sweep favors To-V alone for IP (0.439 versus 0.420), whereas adding To-K adaptation improves TA (0.641 versus 0.607).
Restricting adaptation to values leaves the base token-to-layout mechanism intact and offers a specific identity-oriented design choice.
In the separate copy sweep, K , V K,V copying gives higher TA but lower IP than Q , K Q,K copying.
That pattern is consistent with generic values weakening personalized appearance, and supports retaining the learned value path rather than copying all available features.
Guiding both self- and cross-attention gives higher IP than either alone (0.469 versus 0.449/0.416), while cross-attention-only guidance gives slightly higher TA.
The choice therefore reflects a trade-off, not dominance on every score.
blocks.zh:
为什么调整价值观,保留个性化的内容。 投影扫射只有利于IP(0.439对0.420),而加入To-K适应则改善了TA(0.641对0.607)。
限制对数值的适应使基号对寄出机制完好无损,并提供了一个面向特定身份的设计选择.
在单独的复制扫描中,K,V K,V复制给出的TA比Q,KQ,K复制的IP要高但更低.
这种模式与削弱个性化外观的通用价值是一致的,并支持保留学到的价值路径,而不是复制所有可用的特性。
既指导自我,也指导交叉,使IP比单独(0.469比0.449/0.416)要高,而交叉只指导则给予略高的TA.
因此,这一选择反映了一种取舍,而不是在每一方面占据支配地位。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Guidance-window trade-off. Textual alignment improves up to 20 guided steps, then declines. Identity preservation decreases overall with longer guidance, while sampling latency increases.
blocks.zh: 图5:指导-窗口权衡. 文字一致改进了多达20个指导步骤,然后下降。 随着指导时间的延长,身份保护总体减少,而取样延迟度增加。

blocks.en:
Guidance-window length. Figure 5 shows the identity–alignment trade-off.
Extending guidance from 5 to 20 steps raises TA from 0.667 to 0.723 and latency from 87 to 110 s, while IP changes from 0.469 to 0.405.
We use T W = 20 T_{W}=20 for alignment.
Guiding all 50 steps is slower and lowers both scores relative to 20 steps.
blocks.zh:
指导-窗口长度. 图5显示身份-调整权衡。
将指导从5级提升到20级,使TA从0.667级提升到0.723级,延迟从87级提升到110级,而IP则从0.469级变更到0.405级.
我们用TW = 20 TQW = 20来对齐.
指导所有50步都比较慢,两个分数都比20步低.

blocks.en:
Reference count and adaptation rank. The sweeps in Tab. 3 show that increasing reference images from one to four raises IP from 0.436 to 0.515 while TA remains within 0.694–0.697.
Additional views can thus help appearance learning, but require more user input.
Larger LoRA rank does not consistently improve IP.
blocks.zh:
参考数和适应等级. 扫在塔布. 3显示参考图像从一个增加到四个,使IP从0.436增加到0.515,而TA则保持在0.694-0.697以内.
额外的视图因此可以帮助外观学习,但需要更多的用户输入.
较大的LORA级别并不能持续改进IP.

blocks.en:
Scaling and remaining limitations. The supplementary study composes N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 6 } N\in\{2,3,4,6\} adapters, with ten clips per setting.
IP decreases from 0.487 to 0.218 and detector-based missing subject–frame pairs rise from 0.189 to 0.560 between N = 2 N=2 and N = 6 N=6 despite nearly flat measured resource use.
Scene complexity and subject combinations also vary, so these results do not isolate the cause of failures.
Same-class fusion and human-identity failures are reported in the supplement.
These results distinguish computational scalability from generation quality.
Independent adapters remain reusable across prompts and subject combinations without joint optimization or weight averaging, even as identity preservation degrades and omissions increase when more subjects are composed.
blocks.zh:
扩大和剩余限制。 补充研究由N ∈ {2,3,4,6} N\in \{ 2,3,4,6\} 适配器组成,每个设置有10个片段.
IP从0.487降至0.218,基于探测器的缺失对象-帧对从0.189对上升至0.560对,在N=2N=2和N=6N=6之间,尽管测量资源使用几乎平坦.
场景的复杂性和主题组合也各有不同,因此这些结果不会孤立失败的原因.
补充材料中报告了同级聚变和人识别失败的情况。
这些结果将计算可扩展性与生成质量区分开来.
独立适配器在不进行联合优化或平均重量的情况下,仍可在各种提示和主体组合中重复使用,即使在组成更多主体时,身份保全会降低,遗漏会增加。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduced TokenStream, a novel framework for multi-subject personalized video generation from independently adapted subjects.
Our method leverages Token-wise LoRA for flexible multi-subject control and the T2V-guided stream to reuse pretrained attention structure during inference.
We also proposed Multi-DB , a new benchmark featuring more complex motion and interactions to better evaluate multi-subject generation.
Experiments on Multi-DB and OpenS2V show improved identity preservation and textual alignment over the evaluated TI and DreamBooth baselines, with complementary trade-offs against training-based methods.
blocks.zh:
在这篇论文中,我们介绍了TokenStream,这是从独立改编的学科中进行多题个性化视频生成的新框架.
我们的方法利用Token-wise LoRA来进行灵活的多主体控制和T2V导流在推论中再利用预先训练的注意力结构.
我们还提议建立多主题数据库,这是一个新的基准,其特点是更复杂的运动和互动,以便更好地评价多主题的生成。
关于多数据库和OpenS2V的实验显示,相对于评估的TI和DreamBooth基线而言,身份保存和文字一致得到改善,与基于培训的方法进行了互补权衡。

blocks.en:
TokenStream still has limitations.
Our evaluation focuses on two to three non-human subjects, primarily from distinct classes; human identity, same-class separation, many-subject composition, and articulated animal motion remain challenging.
Large training-based methods retain advantages on several metrics, and extreme subject-prior geometry mismatch can bias the guided trajectory.
blocks.zh:
托肯史崔姆仍有局限性.
我们的评价侧重于主要来自不同阶层的两至三个非人类主体;人类特征、同级分离、许多主体组成以及明确的动物运动仍然是挑战。
基于培训的大型方法在几个度量标准上保留了优势,极端主题优先几何错配可能使导轨偏差.

blocks.en: Appendix A Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实验细节

blocks.en:
We use a single NVIDIA H100 GPU for both training and inference of TokenStream.
All experiments are conducted with Wan2.1-T2V [ 44 ] .
For each subject, we train ToRA for 750 steps with batch size 1, learning rate 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , LoRA rank 16, AdamW, and the flow matching loss.
For inference, we use 50 sampling steps, classifier-free guidance scale 5.0, and resolution 832 × 480 832\times 480 .
Each generated video contains 81 frames. The main protocol uses T W = 20 T_{W}=20 .
The auxiliary scaling, prompt-sensitivity, background and portrait studies instead use the recorded 500-step, 10 − 4 10^{-4} learning-rate, rank-16 recipe with T W = 10 T_{W}=10 ; their detection-based scores are separate from the main benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们使用单一的NVIDIA H100 GPU来进行TokenStream的培训和推论.
所有实验均用Wan2.1-T2V [44]进行.
每门课程,我们训练TORA750步,分批大小1,学习率1×10−5 1\Times 10×5},LORA排名16,AdamW,以及流量匹配损失.
推论,我们使用50个采样步骤,无分级制导尺度为5.0,分辨率为832×480 832\times 480。
每个生成的视频包含81帧. 主协议使用TW = 20 T_{W}=20.
辅助缩放,即时灵敏度,背景和肖像研究则采用所记录的500步,10−4 10^{-4}学习率,排名16的配方与TW=10 T_{W}=10;他们的检测分数与主要基准分开.

blocks.en:
Prompts used for subject learning. Previous optimization-based approaches [ 41 , 13 ] often use simple template prompts such as “a photo of a dog” for subject learning.
In our implementation, each reference image is paired with a detailed caption describing the visible subject and its surrounding context.
The caption helps the frozen text encoder align the reference image with the corresponding subject noun while keeping the actual generation prompt free to specify new actions and interactions.
For example, the dog in the teaser is captioned as: “A dog resting comfortably on a couch in a cozy indoor setting. The couch is upholstered in dark gray fabric with a textured pattern, and there is a decorative pillow featuring a geometric design in dark green with white lines. In the background, a window with horizontal blinds allows some light to filter into the room, and dark curtains hang beside it. The overall ambiance suggests a relaxed and homely environment.”
blocks.zh:
用于科目学习的提示 。 以往基于优化的方法[41,13]经常使用简单的模板提示,如“狗的照片”用于科目学习。
在我们的实施中,每个参考图像都配有描述可见主题及其周围背景的详细标题。
标题帮助被冻结的文本编码器将参考图像与相应的主题名词对齐,同时保持实际生成的及时性以指定新的动作和互动.
例如,取笑器中的狗被描述为:“一只狗在舒适的室内环境中舒适地睡在沙发上。 沙发上装饰着深灰色的布料,带有纹理图案,并有装饰性的枕头,以深绿色为特色,带有白线的几何设计. 在背景中,一个带有水平盲窗的窗口可以让一些光线滤入房间,暗窗帘挂在旁边. 总体气氛表明环境放松和舒适。 “

blocks.en:
Textual Inversion on Wan2.1. We adapt Textual Inversion to Wan2.1 by optimizing the textual embedding of the umT5 [ 9 ] encoder instead of the CLIP [ 40 ] text encoder used in the original image-generation setting.
We train each subject with learning rate 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for 1000 steps and batch size 1.

Wan2.1上的文字反转. 我们通过优化 umT5 [9] 编码器的文本嵌入, 而不是在原始图像生成设置中使用的 CLIP [40] 文本编码器, 来将文本反转修改为 Wan2.1 。
我们每个科目的学习率是1×10×5 1×10×5 ===10×5 = 1000步和批量尺寸1。

运行时间。 我们报告TokenStream在Tab的总运行时间. 6,包括TORA优化和T2V导引推论.

blocks.en: Appendix B Success and Failure Cases Under Shape Mismatch
blocks.zh: 附录B 组合错配的成败案例

blocks.en:
The T2V-guided stream transfers coarse structure and motion from the base Wan2.1 stream by copying Q / K Q/K features during the first T W T_{W} denoising steps.
This guidance acts as an early scaffold rather than a hard constraint because the personalized stream still carries subject-specific values and residual updates.
As a result, TokenStream can preserve moderate subject-shape deviations (shown in Fig. 6 ), but it can still inherit incorrect coarse motion or geometry when the reference subject deviates significantly from the generic prior, as illustrated in Fig. 7 .
blocks.zh:
T2V导流通过在第一个TW TQQW}解密步骤中复制Q/KQ/K特性,从基座Wan2.1流中转移粗结构与运动.
这种指导起到早期脚手架的作用,而不是硬约束的作用,因为个性化的流仍然带有特定主题的值和剩余更新.
因此,TokenStream可以保留适中的主题形状偏差(在图6中显示),但当参考对象与一般前作显著偏差时仍然可以继承不正确的粗运动或几何,如图7所示.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Success case under moderate shape mismatch.
TokenStream preserves the long legs of a Flamingo despite mismatch with the generic “bird” prior.
blocks.zh:
图6:中等形状不匹配情况下的成功案例.
TokenStream保留了火烈鸟的长腿,尽管它与前面的通用“鸟”不匹配。

blocks.en:
Figure 7 : Failure cases under stronger prior mismatch.
When the subject geometry or expected dynamics strongly differs from the generic T2V prior, the guided stream can bias the coarse layout or motion.
These examples illustrate the limitation discussed in the main paper.
blocks.zh:
图7:以往更不匹配的失败案例。
当主题几何或预期动力学与前作的通用T2V有很大差异时,导流会偏向粗糙的布局或运动.
这些例子说明了主要文件所讨论的局限性。

blocks.en: Appendix C Multi-DB benchmark
blocks.zh: 附录C DB 基准

blocks.en: Multi-DB is designed as a targeted stress test for multi-subject personalization rather than a comprehensive benchmark covering all possible subject combinations. It specifically addresses three limitations of existing benchmarks: appearance leakage from textual descriptions, weak inter-subject interactions, and insufficient motion diversity.
blocks.zh: 多功能数据库的设计是针对多主体个性化的压力测试,而不是涵盖所有可能的主题组合的全面基准. 它具体涉及现有基准的三个局限性:文字描述的外观渗漏、主题间互动薄弱和运动多样性不足。

blocks.en:
Subject and prompt statistics. Multi-DB uses 30 subjects from DreamBench [ 41 ] , covering 15 living and non-living classes.
It contains 122 prompts, including 76 two-subject prompts and 46 three-subject prompts.
The prompts are assigned to four motion-difficulty levels, ranging from minimal motion to highly complex dynamics.
blocks.zh:
专题和及时统计。 多DB使用来自Dream Bench的30个学科[41],涵盖15个生活班和非生活班.
它包含122个提示,包括76个双主体提示和46个三主体提示.
提示被分配到四个运动困难级别,从最小运动到高度复杂的动态.

blocks.en:
Prompt construction. We first generated candidate interaction prompts before method-specific tuning.
To construct meaningful subject combinations, we randomly sampled and shuffled subjects from the DreamBench subject set, then prompted GPT to generate a natural video-generation prompt describing interactions among the selected subjects.
The generated prompts were subsequently manually revised to remove explicit appearance descriptions and to ensure that each subject noun is unambiguously associated with its reference image.
For example, a prompt may specify that a “dog” plays with a “toy car”, but should not describe the dog’s color, breed, fur texture, or any other identity-specific attributes, which should instead be inferred from the reference image.
For reproducibility, we include the instruction used for prompt generation below.
blocks.zh:
即时施工. 我们首先在方法特定调制前生成了候选互动提示。
为了构建有意义的主题组合,我们随机抽取和洗涤了Dream Bench主题集中的主题,然后促使GPT生成一个自然的视频生成即时描述选定主题之间的相互作用.
生成的提示随后进行了人工修改,删除了明显的外观描述,并确保每个主题名词与它的参考图像明确相关.
例如,一个提示可以规定, " 狗 " 用 " 玩具车 " 演奏,但不应描述狗的颜色、品种、毛纹或其他任何特定特征,而应从参考图像中推断。
关于可复制性,我们列入以下用于迅速生成的指令。

blocks.en:
GPT prompt. You are given a set of subject names: {SUBJECTS} .
Generate a single natural video-generation prompt that includes all of the given subjects in one coherent scene. Requirements. • Every subject must appear exactly once. • All subjects should participate in meaningful interactions. • Do not describe any appearance attributes, including color, texture, breed, clothing, age, size, identity, or style. • Refer to each subject only by its noun, e.g., “dog”, “toy car”, or “backpack”. • Focus on actions, interactions, scene layout, camera motion, and subject motion. • Produce a single concise paragraph suitable for text-to-video generation.

Level 1 contains mostly static or low-motion scenes, while Level 4 contains stronger subject movement, interaction, or changing spatial relations.
Each prompt was assigned a level by two annotators independently, using the number of moving subjects, the presence of subject-subject interaction, and whether the spatial relation between subjects changes over the clip; disagreements were resolved by discussion.

blocks.en:
On using an LLM to draft prompts. Prompts were drafted by GPT and then revised by hand, and it is fair to ask what bias that introduces.
Three effects are worth naming.
First, LLM-drafted prompts favour a recognizable register: common verbs (“chases”, “rolls”, “jumps”), everyday indoor and park settings, and a tendency toward benign, well-formed scenes. Multi-DB therefore under-represents unusual or adversarial compositions.
Second, an LLM asked to make subjects interact will reliably produce interaction, which is what we wanted, but it also means interaction is distributed fairly evenly rather than sampled from any natural distribution of user requests.
Third, and most relevant to fairness between methods, an LLM prompted to avoid appearance words does not always succeed; this is why every prompt was manually revised to remove residual appearance cues and to check that each subject noun maps unambiguously to one reference image.
The manual revision stage is what makes the benchmark usable for personalization, and it was carried out before any tuning of our method, which reduces method-specific tuning but does not establish the absence of benchmark bias.
We consider the residual register bias a genuine limitation, shared with any LLM-generated benchmark, and one reason we report OpenS2V results alongside Multi-DB rather than in place of them.
blocks.zh:
使用 LLM 来起草提示 。 提示是由GPT起草的,然后通过手方式修改,因此,应当问,引入什么偏见是公平的。
三种效果值得命名.
首先,LLM起草的提示支持一个可识别的登记册:常见动词(“chases”、“rolls”、“jumps”),日常室内和公园环境,以及倾向于良性、成型良好的场景。 因此,多开发银行代表的不是不寻常或对抗性的组成。
其次,一个被请求使主体交互的LLM将可靠地产生交互,这是我们所希望的,但也意味着交互的分布相当均匀,而不是从任何用户请求的自然分布中取样.
第三,而且与方法之间的公平性最相关的是,为了避免外观字词而被激发的LLM并不总是成功的;这就是为什么每个提示都经过手动修改,去除剩余外观提示,并检查每个主题名词的映射是否明确指向一个参考图像.
人工修订阶段是使基准可用于个性化的原因,它是在我们方法的任何调整之前进行的,它减少了方法特定的调整,但并没有确定没有基准偏差。
我们认为,剩余登记册偏差是一个真正的限制,与任何LLM生成的基准相同,而且我们报告OpenS2V结果与多数据库并存的一个原因,而不是取代这些结果。

blocks.en:
We provide additional qualitative comparisons on Multi-DB.
Phantom sometimes omits one of the requested subjects and can exhibit copy-and-paste artifacts where the reference image background is reproduced in the generated video.
VACE often follows the prompt but has weaker identity preservation.

blocks.en:
Three points are worth making explicit.
First, the T2V-guided stream does not instantiate a second model. Both streams evaluate the same frozen Wan2.1 weights, and ToRA is a low-rank branch on the To-V projection that is active only in the main stream, so the additional state is one extra latent together with its activations. Guidance still adds base-model evaluations and activation memory during the first T W T_{W} sampling steps; sharing weights does not eliminate inference overhead.
Second, Textual Inversion and DreamBooth modify only weights or embeddings and leave the sampling loop untouched, so they avoid the extra guided evaluations. Matched comparative inference costs were not measured; DreamBooth additionally requires a merging step whenever a new combination of subjects is requested.
Third, the training-based baselines are feed-forward for a new subject, but that convenience is purchased with a curated corpus of reference-video pairs and a full training run, neither of which appears in a per-video latency measurement. The comparison is therefore between a very large one-time cost and a small recurring one, and which is preferable depends on how often a subject is reused.

三点值得明确。

第二,Textual Inversion和DreamBooth只修改权重或嵌入,使采样循环不受影响,因此它们避免了额外的引导评价. 匹配的比较推论成本没有被计量; DreamBooth另外还要求在要求新的主体组合时采取合并步骤.

blocks.en: A single-frame reference provides limited viewpoint supervision, and the base prior can influence geometry; these examples do not isolate the cause of identity drift.
blocks.zh: 单一框架的参考提供有限的观点监督,前置基可影响几何;这些例子并不孤立身份漂移的原因.

blocks.en: Dedicated identity benchmarks such as the subject mode of VideoAlchemist [ 8 ] are the right evaluation for this question; we could not run them because their evaluation code and reference splits were not available to us. Multi-view references and a tighter guidance schedule are the clearest directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 诸如VideoAlchemist [8] 的主题模式等专用身份基准是这个问题的正确评价;我们无法运行这些基准,因为我们无法获得其评价代码和参考数据。 多观点参考和更严格的指导时间表是今后工作最明确的方向。
